area.hero.h1: Heating and cooling repair in Northbrook, IL
area.hero.lede: Furnaces, central air, heat pumps and rooftop units, for Northbrook houses from the 1950s to today, townhomes, condos and the shops and offices on Lake Cook Rd. Family-owned since 1952, with the owner, Rob, still on the calls.

area.services.heading: Every heating and cooling service we offer in Northbrook
area.who.copy: City & Suburban is run from 1225 N Cleaver St, Chicago, 15.5 miles south-east of Northbrook's nearest edge. Rob, the owner, still runs the calls and does the diagnosis on the jobs that need it.
area.reviews.1.quote: I called City & Suburban Heating to have my furnaces cleaned. They told me that Rob was going out of town for a week. I asked he could come before he left, and he came two days after my call. I had forgotten to buy a furnace filter for one of the furnaces, but luckily he had it in his truck. He is very reliable and does a great job.
area.reviews.2.quote: Highly recommend this service. Responsive, reliable, and reasonable pricing. Twice in the past few years, Rob has fixed our aging furnace but this frigid Friday night it kicked the bucket for good. Saturday morning the guys were at our house putting up a new one. Excellent customer service, punctuality, and clear explanations. C&S Heating look for solutions to fix vs selling you unnecessary spare parts.
area.reviews.3.quote: Very quick response and was clear on the issue and solution! Rob came out to our place to assess the issue on our furnace and fixed it within a same day! He was transparent on the status of the furnace and provided the solution of the issue im having right away. Definitely found a local business who I can rely on that will come back for sure!
area.reviews.4.quote: Great experience. I called them for my second opinion. Fast, friendly and efficient service. I was told my unit is near end of life but the prices I was quoted are great and they will definitely be hearing from me again when it's time. Use this company. Update: had my ac, furnace, and water heater replaced yesterday. Not sure I could be happier.
area.scope.heading: The same repair costs differently in a 1960s house, a townhome and an office
area.scope.1.why: Larger Northbrook houses can run a furnace and AC for each floor, so a repair starts with finding which system has failed.
area.scope.2.why: Newer houses and townhomes may run heat pumps, which heat and cool. The repair depends on which half has failed.
area.scope.3.why: In townhome and condo associations, the rules on outdoor units and access shape when and how the work is done.
area.scope.4.why: Furnaces sit in basements, but some newer houses put a second unit in the attic, which changes the access.
area.scope.5.why: Shops on Lake Cook Rd and offices on Sanders Rd run rooftop units, so roof access and business hours set the work.
area.scope.6.why: The biggest swing of all. Where the unit has years left, we say so.

area.buildings.heading: What heats and cools your Northbrook building
area.buildings.1.title: 1950s-70s house
area.buildings.1.body: A furnace with central air, usually in the basement. The condenser sits beside the house.
area.buildings.2.title: Newer two-story house
area.buildings.2.body: Often two furnaces and two AC systems, one per floor, sometimes with a unit in the attic.
area.buildings.3.title: Townhome or condo
area.buildings.3.body: A furnace or heat pump per unit, with central air. The association sets rules for outdoor units.
area.buildings.4.title: Shop or office
area.buildings.4.body: Rooftop units for the stores and offices on Lake Cook Rd, Skokie Blvd and Sanders Rd.

area.faq.heading: Northbrook HVAC, answered
area.faq.1.q: Is the furnace in my 1960s house worth repairing, or does it need replacing?
area.faq.2.q: Do you come out to Northbrook from Chicago?
area.faq.3.q: Can you service both systems in a two-zone house?
area.faq.4.q: Does HVAC work in Northbrook need a permit?
area.faq.1.a: Often it's worth repairing. We diagnose first, and where the furnace has years left, we say so. Replacement is quoted only when the repair stops making sense.
area.cta.body: Have the make of your furnace or condenser to hand, and tell us what it's doing. If the house has two systems, tell us which floor has the problem.

extras.faq.2.a: Yes. Northbrook is on our service area list, about 16 miles north-west of the shop at 1225 N Cleaver St, and Rob runs the calls from there.
extras.faq.3.a: Yes. Furnace and air conditioning repair and maintenance are on our list of services. Tell us which floor isn't heating or cooling, and we start there.
extras.faq.4.a: It depends on the job. The Village of Northbrook takes mechanical permit applications for heating and cooling work, mostly installs and replacements. Ask whoever quotes an install who pulls the permit.

permits.source: No permit graph: City of Chicago building permits (ydr8-5enu) stop at the city limits, and the Village of Northbrook doesn't publish its permits as open data.
permits.village_data: Village of Northbrook: Mechanical Application (Form 1.4, Development & Planning Services, 1225 Cedar Lane) for heating and cooling work; 2024 International Mechanical Code amendments list permit exemptions. Applications go by email to Permits@Northbrook.il.us; no open permit dataset found (searched 15 Oct 2026). City & Suburban: 0 in the Chicago file, all years.
